Validated by Science. Science You Can Taste. Results You Can Track. VERISOL® — Skin Deep, Literally. CERAMOSIDES™ — Sourced With Standards. Hyaluronic Acid — The Hydration Everyone Already Trusts. Inside Liposomal Beauty Peptide Complex Ceramosides ™ What it is: Ceramosides™ is a patent pending, fast-acting, wheat phytoceramide complex. The first plant-derived ceramide ingredient on the market with clinically proven efficacy on skin hydration, anti-aging, and hair growth and strength. Why we use it: Ceramides are the "mortar" that holds skin cells together and the structural lipids that reinforce hair strands. Ceramosides™ works to support the skin and hair's natural lipid barrier. Backed by 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trials on skin and 2 on hair, it's shown to visibly reduce wrinkles and improve hydration, and to promote hair growth. Hyaluronic acid What it is: Hyaluronic acid is a naturally occurring polysaccharide known for its exceptional ability to bind and retain water. Why we use it: Hyaluronic acid supports skin hydration. Natural levels decline with age, so replenishing it may help support a more hydrated look and feel. Tri-Amino Acid Blend What it is: The Tri-Amino Acid Complex features glycine, proline, and lysine, three of the primary amino acids that make up collagen. Why we use it: These amino acids are core building blocks of collagen peptide. Glycine is the most abundant, making up roughly 33% of collagen's total amino acid sequence. This small amino acid forms the core structure that allows collagen chains to wind into a tight triple helix, giving skin, joints, and connective tissue their strength and flexibility. Proline, along with its derivative hydroxyproline, makes up about 23% of collagen's amino acids and helps stabilize that same triple helix structure. Lysine is an essential amino acid the body uses to build and cross-link collagen fibers, playing a direct role in how collagen forms and holds together over time. VERISOL® Bioactive Collagen Peptide What it is: VERISOL® is a Bioactive Collagen Peptide, a specific, clinically studied form of hydrolyzed collagen sourced from bovine and optimized to target the cells responsible for your skin, hair, and nail health. Why we use it: Collagen naturally declines with age, dropping about 1% a year starting in early adulthood, with women losing up to 30% after menopause. This leads to fine lines, reduced elasticity, and skin that struggles to retain moisture. VERISOL® works differently than regular collagen. Its unique peptide sequence acts like a "lock and key," stimulating your skin's own fibroblasts to produce more of your body's natural collagen, rather than simply adding collagen from an outside source. This targeted action is why VERISOL® is the most clinically studied collagen peptide for beauty benefits, with published research showing it helps reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, improve skin elasticity and hydration, support fuller, thicker looking hair, and strengthen nails to help minimize splitting and cracking. How to use How Rip. Sip. Or drizzle it over your favorite food — your call. When Daily. Consider it non-negotiable. Dose 1 packet — no measuring, no guesswork. Notes Morning person or night owl, it works either way. Got questions? We have answers! Is Beauty Peptide Complex gluten-free if it contains wheat? What type of collagen does it contain? Is this just a collagen supplement? Do I still need a separate hair, skin, or nail supplement? *The FDA only evaluates foods and drugs, not supplements like these products.
